Description

For Research Use Only. Not for human or veterinary use. Not for use in diagnostic or therapeutic procedures. Not approved by the FDA or any regulatory body for human consumption, treatment, cure, or prevention of any disease.

CJC-1295 is a synthetic peptide supplied for in-vitro research into extended-duration GHRH receptor agonism and related pituitary signaling pathways.

In research settings, CJC-1295 is studied for its prolonged receptor engagement profile, particularly in models evaluating sustained growth hormone pulsatility and comparative pharmacokinetics against native GHRH.

By purchasing this product, the buyer certifies they are a qualified researcher acquiring it exclusively for laboratory research use, and assumes full responsibility for its legal, safe, and appropriate handling in accordance with all applicable laws.
